licence.note: Only a protectzone-01 build writes _protectzone_mode (zones=N why=ok|absent|stale:... ids=... world=...), once per spawn and on every change. With the fixture installed the canary's rows read zones=1 why=ok; zones=0 why=absent means the fixture is missing (INCONCLUSIVE).

draw_exposure.note: Every drawable pool gets the fixture before the launch (the fixture is the exposure); no draw requirement beyond the default.

exposure.note: licence zones>=1 on every drawn pool AND canary bot-minutes inside the fixture boxes >= 60 AND protection events (find_filtered + refusals + mine walk-outs) >= 10.

own_lines.note: Z1: a canary bot inside a zone box for >= 15 min with < 3 blocks moved (the dead end the guard must never make).
Z2: >= 60 refusals by one bot in 10 min (a refusal whose remedy is never taken).
ARMS: a control _protectzone_mode / _protect_zone / _protect_zone_refused row after the deploy. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS: a zones>=1 why=ok licence row on every drawn pool (the fixture is in place). BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: control bots seen inside their pool's fixture box >= 1 (the ground is visited; positions readable). BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED: gather successes per bot-h, DiD (should not fall: the strip is 25 x 21 columns of a world); refusals by op; survival_allowed.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (immobiledid).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. Then `protectzone-fixture.py --remove` (the data) unless the next run wants it.

extension.note: Tier 2: KEEP at +180 when exposed (exactly 4 pools, >= 48 bot-h, no WATCH/HOLD, kind licence, death rate <= control, clean baseline); extend only for exposure.

requires: the fleet on 9e7d9980 (cobblekeep-01 KEPT and promoted), or a rebase onto the live tip.
